issues.detail: The Hebrew name יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת (Jehosheba) is rendered as 耶洗別亞大, which mixes the name of Jezebel (耶洗別) with an extra element. The correct transliteration should be 約示巴 or 耶何示巴.

The Hebrew name עֲתַלְיָהוּ (Athaliah) is rendered as 亞大利雅, which is a plausible transliteration but the standard Chinese rendering is 亞他利雅; however, the more significant issue is the confusion with the first name.

The Chinese adds '約蘭的女兒' (daughter of Jehoram) which is not present in the Hebrew text; the Hebrew only says 'daughter of the king' (בַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ) and later 'daughter of the king Jehoram' (בַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹרָם) — the addition of '約蘭的女兒' in the first clause is an extra identification not in the Hebrew at that point.
